name: cyango
description: Edit a live Cyango xr/studio story: scenes, layout, models, and interactions.

interface.longDescription:
Cyango edits the story that is open in Cyango xr/studio. Ask for a change in plain words and see it land in the editor: add and arrange scenes, build GUI panels, buttons and text, place 3D models, primitives, lights and Gaussian splats, wire up actions and timelines, and insert free stock images and models with their author and license.

Sign in with your Cyango account when you connect. Then open a story in Cyango xr/studio and turn MCP on in Story Settings. Saving stays a manual step in the editor.

Guide: https://cyango.com/docs/studio/ai-agents-mcp
defaultPrompt: Turn the first scene into a hotel-lobby welcome: a large title, one line of copy, and a Start button.
Stage a showroom in the first scene: a pedestal, a red sphere, and a warm spotlight aimed at it.
Find a free coastline photo, place it in the first scene, and credit the photographer and license.

positive.description: List the scenes of the open story
positive.prompt: Name every scene in the story I have open.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the name and type of each scene in the story open in Cyango xr/studio. Nothing in the story changes.

positive.prompt: Add a scene called Gallery so I can send visitors there next.
positive.expected_behavior: A scene named Gallery appears in the scene list of the open editor.

positive.prompt: In the first scene, build a welcome panel: the title Welcome, one line under it, and a Start button.
positive.expected_behavior: A panel appears in the first scene with a Welcome title, a line of text under it, and a Start button under the text.

positive.description: Add and then change a 3D object
positive.prompt: In the first scene, put a red sphere on a pedestal, then make the sphere twice as big.
positive.expected_behavior: A pedestal and a red sphere appear in the first scene, then the sphere's scale doubles.

positive.prompt: Find a free coastline photograph, place it in the first scene, and tell me the photographer and the license.
positive.expected_behavior: A coastline photograph from a free provider appears in the first scene, and the reply names the photographer and the license.
